title: Empty FILTER or DROP results return #CALC!, whereas out-of-range CHOOSECOLS or shrinking EXPAND dimensions return #VALUE!
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, dynamic array functions distinguish empty results from invalid indices or dimensions: FILTER with no matching elements and no if_empty argument returns #CALC!, and DROP removing all rows or columns returns #CALC!, whereas CHOOSECOLS with an out-of-range column index and EXPAND with target rows or columns smaller than the input array return #VALUE!.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in f3_arrays (rows 3-5, 20-24, 31-32) and matched across 3,000/3,000 FILTER, 2,400/2,400 DROP, 3,000/3,000 CHOOSECOLS, and 3,000/3,000 EXPAND full-bank rows.
